newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes up on fundamentals and Iraq.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes up on fundamentals and Iraq.

text.p: IPE gas oil futures closed $2.25 a tonne higher on what brokers said was good fundamental demand for heating oil on both sides of the Atlantic and a crude rally over tensions in the Middle East Gulf.
Oct gas oil closed at $221.75 a tonne, gaining strength late in the session after NYMEX heating oil broke through psychological resistance of 70 cents a gallon.
"It's fundamentally quite strong. We are seeing demand from Germany and other parts of Europe," a floor broker said.
"You have very low heat stocks in Europe and the United States and there is no reason for it to come down," he added.

The market was waiting on Gulf developments over the weekend after U.S. warplanes and a second aircraft carrier converged on the Gulf on Friday in readiness to punish Iraqi President Saddam Hussein for shooting at Western patrols over no-fly zones.
The Gulf tensions kept Brent aloft near its highs. Oct Brent traded up 33 cents at $24.20 a barrel at 1700 GMT, just off the intra-day high of $24.27 a barrel.
